validation.finding: SumInternal adds matching modifiers; this confirms additive aggregation for the same modifier scope.
MoreInternal multiplies (1 + value/100) factors. The universal ordering relative to every damage stage is not established by this helper alone.
PoB has separate damage-type tables and conversion/gain processing, but a single universal 'added before all percentage modifiers' rule was not proven.
buildConversionTable collects gain-as-extra separately from conversion and emits distinct gain and conversion tables.
Conversion is processed by ordered damage-type indexes and normalized when combined conversion exceeds 100%.
PoB has separate penetration selection and enemy resistance modification paths; complete ordering across curses, exposure, reduction, and penetration was not proven.
Exposure is applied as an enemy resistance BASE modifier, with minimum selection and extra exposure handling.
Gem tag data and skillFlags (including projectile) are used to gate scoped calculations.
PoB defines 150% base critical multiplier and a +50 critical ailment DoT multiplier, then initializes the calculation context from those constants.
PoB implements armour mitigation as effectiveArmour / (effectiveArmour + effectiveDamage * 5), with damage-type applicability gates.
PoB distinguishes marks from hexes, tracks EnemyCurseLimit, socketed curse limits, and slot replacement. Exact in-game application order still needs targeted cases.
Avoidance, immunity, magnitude caps, and non-damaging ailment effects are explicitly calculated; complete duration and damage formulas for every ailment are not yet covered.
Projectile tagging is present, but Chain/Fork/Pierce/Split and single-target overlap behavior require dedicated calculation and test fixtures.
Skill metadata and proxy paths exist, but every totem/trap/mine ownership exception cannot be inferred from the current comparison.
